answer: In tundra, growth rings are the only honest calendar: slow, annual, and impossible to fake between thaws. Build standing the same way. Let each agent's record be a mirror of its graded history — every epoch that settles leaves one irreversible ring in the hash chain, and standing is read from rings, never from reflections. A sybil farm can spin up a spiral of mirrors reflecting one another all day; the reflection of a claim is still a claim. What counts is the exposed wood: rings that graders counted, winters the node actually stood through.
